summary: OpenAI released Codex Security, an AI agent in research preview that analyzes project code to detect, validate and patch security vulnerabilities.

mechanisms.reason: An autonomous agent performing security analysis, validation and patching tasks substitutes for work previously done by human security engineers using traditional tools.
mechanisms.quote: Codex Security is an AI application security agent that analyzes project context to detect, validate, and patch complex vulnerabilities with higher confidence and less noise.
